title: Images of universally closed and proper morphisms into a separated scheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in a commutative triangle over a separated base, a universally closed (respectively proper) morphism to the base remains universally closed (respectively proper) when regarded as a morphism to the middle scheme, so that in particular its image is closed. The proof factors the morphism through the fibre product with the middle scheme and uses that the first factor is a closed immersion, hence proper and universally closed, while the second factor is a base change of the original morphism and therefore inherits universal closedness and properness.
